# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge is not a suggestion—it's a battle cry. Three commands, back to back: be watchful, stand firm, act like men. The world tells you strength is optional, that discipline is outdated, that faith is a private hobby. Scripture says otherwise. God designed you to stand when others fold, to lead when others drift, to fight for what is good and true. But notice the order: watchfulness comes before strength. A man who charges ahead without discernment is just a bull in a china shop. Real strength is rooted in attentiveness—to God's Word, to your own heart, to the enemy's schemes. You cannot stand firm on ground you haven't claimed. So before the day hits you, before the emails and the noise and the temptation, plant your feet on the Rock. Then act like men. Not perfect men. Not men who never fall. Men who get up, who lead, who refuse to quit.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups. On each one, say the words: "Stand firm." Let your body and your spirit agree.
